paper_style.palette_strategy: 方法图反复使用浅蓝/蓝表示分布和信息流，绿色表示可行/保留，红色表示不可行/拒绝，橙色表示候选/轨迹，黄色表示 pruning，紫蓝渐变表示噪声。Figure 5 另以七色 U 系列和 viridis heatmap 表示 B×U success；Figure 2/6/7 的自然图像色与 prompt 高亮不承担统一定量变量。表格全部黑白 booktabs，粗体/下划线强调 best/second-best。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Compositional Diffusion with Guided Search (CDGS) composes short-horizon plan distributions to sample long-horizon goal-directed plans directly at inference. Unlike naïve compositional sampling, it explores diverse plans and filters locally inconsistent paths to avoid “mode averaging”, yielding globally coherent plans.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Running example. (a) Consider a 1D-domain of {x1:7 } variable distributions and {y1:6 } feasible directed transitions between the variables. There are two feasible long-horizon plans from start (x1 ) to goal (x7 ): one through the top and one through the bottom. (b) in naive-composition, sampled plans may choose to start in the top and end at the bottom, or vice versa. When this happens, the intermediate models {y2:5 } will average the modes of intermediate variables {x2:6 } to satisfy both constraints, manifesting in infeasible transitions (red) (c) adding iterative resampling reduces the frequency of mode-averaging (d) adding pruning eliminates plans with infeasible y

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Compositional diffusion with Guided Search. At each denoising timestep, CDGS iteratively denoises a batch of noisy candidate global plans by (i) iterative resampling to propagate information through averaged scores at overlaps (blue) and (ii) pruning candidates with local inconsistencies based on the predicted clean samples (yellow). This process ensures all local plans align and belong to high-likelihood regions of p(y), producing globally coherent plans.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色框/路径=composition/resampling；黄色框/路径=local feasibility/pruning；绿色 check=保留、红色 cross=拒绝；紫蓝渐变=噪声 batch；灰色=辅助张量/高斯。

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: Left: Visualizing plan pruning. When compositional sampling chooses an infeasible mode sequence, the resulting plan can hallucinate out-of-distribution transitions due to mode-averaging as explained in Sec. 3. For instance, (a) Infeasible transitions: inhand(hook) precondition is never met for place(hook), and (b) State hallucination: cube moves under(rack) as a result of averaging toward the goal state, despite being geometrically infeasible for push(cube, hook). Our pruning objective (Eq. 5) ensures only feasible plans during denoising, where all transitions are in-distribution with our short-horizon transition diffusion model. Right: Scaling analysis. (H-7) denotes performance averaged over tasks of horizon 7. (c) Task planning success improves with batch size, with larger gains from more resampling steps. (d) Motion planning success improves with resampling steps, but only when batch size is large enough

design_weaknesses: 14 列极密，4D/17D 只靠换行 header 区分。
没有单位、成功判定细节和 ± 定义。
两行不足以展示环境异质性。

tables.reusable_pattern: 用短/长 baseline + naive + w/o component + full method 呈现长程 quality tradeoff，同时补指标定义、分母和不确定性。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 说明 mode averaging 与 CDGS pipeline，Figure 2 预览三域，Figure 3 在 toy domain 中逐步加入 resampling/pruning，Figure 4 展开 denoising/DDIM 接口，Tables 1–3 和 Figure 5 给机器人比较、failure 与 B×U scaling，Figure 6/7 和 Tables 4/5 给 panorama/video 的定性—定量证据与 tradeoff。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 全部对象使用 Figure/Table n: 前缀，标题短语通常粗体，随后给设置、比较和方向性发现；Figure 4/5 明确定义局部颜色或 H-7，Table 1/2/4/5 给出 trial/prompt/尺寸设置，但所有 ± 均未命名，Figure 3 caption 实际截断为 infeasible y。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1/2 使用平面方法列并以环境/维度分组；Table 3 用 task-information 双层组表头；Table 4/5 用指标方向箭头。粗体/下划线复用 best/second-best，无色块；Table 1/2 成功率 0–100 与 Table 3 的 0–1 未统一标单位。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 4 的 resampling/pruning 接口连接 Figure 5(a/b) failure、Figure 5(c/d) scaling、Tables 1–3 的 Ours/w/o PR、Tables 4–5 的跨域代理指标和 Figure 7 filmstrip。缺少独立 w/o resampling 与同 compute 的正交消融，因此图表支持联合有效而非单独因果贡献。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: PDF 没有实际 appendix 页；Figure 6 指 App. A，Table 5 指 App. B，正文还调用 App. D/E/F/H/J/K。项目页和官方仓库只能部分补充图像资产、代码和渲染路径，不能替代缺失 appendix 的 prompts、超参数、证明和完整统计。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: caption/表格使用 Nimbus Roman，图内标注使用 Aptos/Cambria Math/Arial/Calibri；字号和导入资产差异使表格系统高度一致而图内系统仅局部一致。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝/浅蓝、绿、红、橙、黄在 Figure 1/3/4/5 中分别承担路径、可行性、拒绝和机制语义；Figure 6/7 使用自然图像和 prompt 高亮，Table 1–5 使用黑白。颜色语义可追踪但不全篇统一，且灰度安全性有限。

most_reusable_patterns: prior failure 与 proposed pipeline 同画布对齐（Figure 1）。
固定 toy domain、逐步加入组件（Figure 3）。
failure case、单变量 scaling 和交互 heatmap 合并（Figure 5）。
固定 prompt/时间索引的 filmstrip 与代理指标表配对（Figures 6–7、Tables 4–5）。
highest_value_objects: Figure 5：failure、ablation 与 inference-time scaling 共图。
Table 3：TAMP 信息特权分组与 CDGS/w/o PR 对照。
Figure 6 + Table 4：全局/局部图像一致性的定性—定量配对。
Table 5 + Figure 7：视频质量 tradeoff 与 pruning 消融。
failure_patterns: 图内小字体和颜色依赖影响缩小/灰度可读性。
Table 1/2 与 Table 3 的 success-rate 量纲不一致，± 类型未命名。
baseline 借用、训练/推理预算、样本选择和分母边界未完全对齐。
缺失 appendix 指针、独立 resampling 消融和部分图表原始生成源。
Figure 3 caption 截断为 infeasible y，Figure 5 caption 无句号。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以 mode averaging 失败→denoising 内搜索/重采样/pruning→机器人与跨域定性—定量验证为主线，用局部蓝绿红黄语义和黑白 booktabs 串联机制、消融与长程一致性，但小字号、未命名不确定性、跨表单位和缺失附录限制复现与比较。
